page.overview:
Who is Yasmine?

Please note: In this Filipino name, the middle name or maternal family name is “Delos Santos” and the surname or paternal family name is “Bautista”.

Yasmine's look is inspired by the Philippine eagle (agila). Her karambit is also styled after the eagle, with etchings like the eagle in flight, and a feather charm at the end of the blade. Yasmine also has baybayin script read as [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baybayin (ᜉᜒᜎᜒᜉᜒᜈᜐ᜕ Pilipinas)] on her belt and Buscalan-inspired snake skin accents usually seen in traditional tattoos and star earrings.

Her full name was revealed to be Yasmine Delos Santos Bautista, a detail made known only upon her official release.

Yasmine's defining characteristic is her dual personalities, visualized by her hairstyle. Normally, she is a meek, shy, and socially awkward girl who has trouble communicating with others. However, when she dons her hairband and sweeps up her bangs before the fight, her upbeat tomboyish persona emerges. The latter persona appears to be the way Yasmine tried to overcome anxiety and prove herself as a capable fighter.
